title: Embedded skills bundle: root embed package + internal/skills
description:
Foundation. Create the embedded skills bundle and its accessor package.

CONSTRAINT (Go embed): a go:embed directive can only reference paths in or below its own package directory, and never through symlinks. skills/ticks/** lives at the repo root, so the embed .go file must live in a package whose directory is the repo root or an ancestor of skills/. The accepted approach: a new root-level file (e.g. embedded.go, package name distinct from main packages, module root has no package today - verify) OR a tiny package at the root like ticksskills/ CANNOT reach ../skills - so root-level file it is. Verify with go build before building on it.

Deliverables:
1. Root-level embed file exposing an embed.FS of skills/ticks/** (ALL of it: SKILL.md + references/ incl. runners-config.schema.json). Exclude nothing; the bundle must be byte-identical to the committed tree.
2. Package internal/skills: List() (skill names - today just "ticks"), Files(name) (fs.FS of that skill), Read(name, path), Version() (the tk build version via the existing version mechanism - find how cmd/tk surfaces its version and reuse it, do not invent a second source), and Verify(root string) which compares the embedded bundle byte-for-byte against an on-disk skills/ tree and reports any drift (path lists + differing files).
3. Tests: bundle contains SKILL.md and every references/*.md + the schema json; Verify() against the repo tree passes (this test IS the CI embed-freshness guard - it runs in normal go test and fails if someone edits skills/ without... wait, embed happens at build time so the test recompiles with the current tree and always passes - therefore ALSO add a test asserting specific load-bearing files exist and are non-trivial (size floor), and document in the package doc why embed-freshness is structurally guaranteed at build time (the embed IS the tree) while RELEASED binaries are guaranteed by the tag build. Reason about this honestly in doc.go rather than shipping a tautological guard.

Boundaries: no cmd/ changes (later ticks own the CLI); no changes under skills/ itself. Run gofmt, go vet, and the full test suite per .tick/config.md Testing. Commit all work in your worktree with message prefix "tick <this-tick-id>: ".
